posts.author: pestercide
posts.body:
I didn't know how else to word this but I was just wondering if it was possible to use hand-drawn assets (like tilesets and character sprites) in RPG Maker 2003 instead of pixel art? To be more specific I mean art made digitally in a program such as Clip Studio Paint. Would this be possible or does RM2k3 not support that kinda stuff?
I've seen it done in newer versions of RPG Maker but haven't found any answers regarding this specific version

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body: I've seen some, but nowadays with screens bigger than 1024x768 they would look really weird, and they would usually be pixelated.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body: It's rare, but you can find games where the player and NPCs are Pictures instead of Characters, which allows for larger graphics, but these systems are exclusive to their developers and often present bugs due to the method used. I've even created some tech demos where even the maps are Pictures using coordinate reading to represent the objects on the real map.

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body: Google "Sunset over Imdahl" as an example.
